scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @rhythm-game/chart-schema && npm run build --workspace @rhythm-game/web
scripts.check:licenses: node scripts/check-node-licenses.mjs && uv run --project services/api python scripts/check_python_licenses.py
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project services/api uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/api --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts tests && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project services/api ruff check services/api/app services/api/tests scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @rhythm-game/chart-schema && npm run typecheck --workspace @rhythm-game/web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run --project services/api mypy services/api/app services/api/tests scripts/check_python_licenses.py
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace @rhythm-game/chart-schema && npm run test --workspace @rhythm-game/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:licenses && npm test && npm run build
